description: Reference golden I/O for text.summarize (Qwen map/reduce) production validation path

input.inlineText: EdgeMint routes document tasks to enrolled workers. Workers report device capabilities at enrollment and receive assignments with fence tokens. Summarization uses hierarchical map-reduce when input exceeds the context budget.

data.summary: EdgeMint assigns document work to enrolled workers using capability reports and fence tokens; long text is summarized via hierarchical map-reduce.
keyPoints: Workers enroll with device capability reports
Assignments carry fence tokens for safe execution
Summarization scales via map-reduce beyond context limits
